summary: Linkage Global Inc filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Sales Agreement with Craft Capital Management LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $16,000,000 in Class A ordinary shares. The ATM offering is conducted under an existing effective shelf registration statement on Form F-3. The company is not obligated to sell any shares and the sales agent will use commercially reasonable efforts to execute sales based on company instructions. A 3.0% commission will be paid on gross proceeds. This is a routine equity capital-raising facility, not a special situation.
